name: io.github.crisjonblvx/enrichr-api
title: Enrichr
description: 50 billed utilities for AI agents. Launch without a key to browse/signup; 1,000 calls/month free after email verification.

environmentVariables.name: ENRICHR_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional at launch. Without a key, use signup/recover/catalog tools first; configure the returned key to use billed utilities. Verified accounts receive 1,000 free calls/month.

environmentVariables.name: ENRICHR_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL (default: https://enrichrapi.dev). Useful for self-hosted deployments.
